...If people see you talking to me, they'll
mistake you as a friend of an <CLT=cltSTRONG>assassin<CLT=cltNORMAL>.
<CLT=cltMIND>Should I hang out with Maki for a while?

...And you're still fine with that? If you're
putting up a front, then you'll get hurt later.
<CLT=cltMIND>Maki and I grew a little closer today.
